newsitem.title: USA: U S West Interactive invests in Student.net.
newsitem.headline: U S West Interactive invests in Student.net.

text.p: U S WEST Interactive Services, a unit of U S West Media Group, said Thursday it acquired a 35 percent stake in Student.Net Publishing, an Internet publishing company founded in 1995 by students at Yale and Columbia Universities.
U S West said it is the sole investor in Student.Net Publishing, a New Haven-based company that publishes a web site for college students. The size of the investment was not disclosed.

As a part of the pact, Student.Net will work with U S WEST Interactive to develop local editions of the Student.Net web site for universities located in cities served by DiveIn, U S WEST's Web-based community information service slated to launch in 10 cities this month.
Student.Net also will develop audio and video programming for cable modems and networks provided through U S West Media Group's businesses, the company said.
